title: Monogamous quantum corrections to holographic mutual information
authors: César A. Agón, Javier Molina-Vilaplana, Javier Moreno
abstract: We construct an extensive model of bulk mutual information (MI) in anti-de Sitter spacetime and use it to describe the leading quantum corrections to the MI of certain holographic theories. The equivalence between bulk and boundary MI follows from the Faulkner--Lewkowycz--Maldacena prescription. We show that the extensivity of the bulk MI is sufficient for the quantum-corrected boundary entropy vector to satisfy monogamy of MI and all other holographic entropy cone inequalities. Our model is built from a covariantly conserved current-current kernel in AdS and is realized explicitly by a free massive Dirac fermion, whose boundary MI at long distances is that of a fermionic generalized free field (GFF). The construction also reproduces the expected short-distance divergence structure of a GFF, and the current-current correlator defines a positive and monotonically decreasing function along the renormalization-group flow. We illustrate this explicitly for disjoint half-disks at the conformal fixed point of the model in AdS$_3$, where we present the exact result.
summary: This theoretical paper develops an extensive model for bulk Mutual Information in AdS spacetime using the correlator of a massive Dirac fermion. By demonstrating that the bulk MI's extensivity implies the satisfaction of holographic entropy inequalities on the boundary, the authors provide a rigorous framework for understanding quantum corrections to entanglement in holographic theories.
main_problem: The paper aims to construct an extensive model for bulk Mutual Information (MI) in Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime to describe quantum corrections to holographic MI.
main_result: It is shown that the extensivity of the bulk MI is sufficient to guarantee that the quantum-corrected boundary entropy vector satisfies all holographic entropy cone inequalities, including monogamy of MI.
method: The authors use the Faulkner–Lewkowycz–Maldacena prescription and model the bulk MI using a covariantly conserved current-current kernel derived from a free massive Dirac fermion.
model_or_system: The physical context is holographic theories governed by the AdS/CFT correspondence. The model is realized explicitly using the current-current correlator of a free massive Dirac fermion in AdS spacetime.

main_assumptions: The primary assumption is that positive and exactly extensive bulk MI is sufficient for satisfying the HEC inequalities. The analysis also relies on the FLM prescription to capture subleading quantum corrections.

paper_structure: The paper develops the MI functional using the current-current correlator, establishes the connection between bulk extensivity and boundary constraints, and explicitly calculates the MI in both long-distance and short-distance limits using the free fermion model.
why_interesting: The connection between geometric properties (extensivity) of bulk quantities and fundamental quantum information constraints (monogamy) provides a powerful, universal tool for testing quantum gravity models in condensed matter analogues.
